meta.parties: Saibo v. James Appu Et Al

rules.statement: A landowner cannot acquire a prescriptive right to overhanging eaves, and the owner of the land beneath the eaves must remove them if they wish to build a taller structure.
rules.supporting_quote: "I understand the plaintiff's case is a claim for a right to occupy a space over the defendants' land. ... The projections here referred to are balconies (mceniana) and the eaves of houses (suggrunda), which do not rest on the wall of the neighbouring proprietor, but simply overhang his land."
